_about: Generic place tags for any genre (idea from Worlds Without Number; all text is our own). Roll two for a place, then pull one item from each list. A World Kit can add its own under place_tags.

tags.name: Old Debt
tags.description: Someone here owes something they cannot pay, and the bill has come due.
enemies: a collector who enjoys the work
the creditor's patient, polite agent
a rival who bought the debt cheap
friends: the debtor's child, desperate for help
a clerk who can make records vanish
a former partner with a grudge against the creditor
complications: the debt is lawful and the law will enforce it
paying it would ruin someone innocent
the debtor already spent the money on something worse
things: a hidden stash the debtor forgot to mention
collateral nobody was meant to see
places: a pawn shop full of other people's lives

tags.name: Iron Hand
tags.description: One ruler holds this place by fear, and most people have learned to look away.
enemies: the ruler's favourite enforcer
an informer who sells out neighbours
a captain who likes the power more than the pay
friends: a quiet resistance cell
a guard who will not fire on a crowd
a merchant paying protection and keeping a ledger
complications: the ruler keeps a worse threat at bay
the people fear change more than the ruler
the resistance is as cruel as the regime
things: a list of names marked for arrest
proof the ruler's claim is false
places: the public square where examples are made
a cellar where people meet in whispers

tags.name: Broken Seal
tags.description: Something sealed away long ago has been opened, and it is waking up.
enemies: the thing that was sealed
the fool who opened it, now its servant
a zealot who wants it fully free
friends: a descendant of the original wardens
a scholar who half understands the seal
a survivor who saw it first
complications: resealing it needs a price someone must pay
it is offering people what they want
the seal held something else back too
places: a shrine that still remembers the binding

tags.name: Two Crowns
tags.description: Two powers both claim this place, and everyone must pick a side or pay both.
enemies: a tax collector from each side
a fixer playing both
a hothead who wants open war
friends: a family with members on both sides
a mediator nobody trusts yet
a smuggler who knows the gaps
complications: helping one side hands the place to the other's revenge
both claims are partly true
a third power waits for them to bleed
things: the seal that proves one claim
a treaty both sides want buried
places: the border line through the middle of town

tags.name: Plague Ground
tags.description: A sickness, blight or poison is spreading, and nobody agrees on its cause.
enemies: a profiteer selling false cures
the source, hidden and spreading
an official who would burn the district
friends: an overworked healer
a gravedigger who notices patterns
a family that is somehow immune
complications: the cure is scarce and someone must choose
the party may already carry it
the cause is something the town depends on
things: a sample of the true source
a cartload of the real medicine

tags.name: Lost Heir
tags.description: Someone here has a claim to great power and does not know it, or is hiding it.
enemies: the current holder of the power
an assassin already looking
a schemer who wants a puppet
friends: the old servant who keeps the secret
the heir's unwitting friend
a record-keeper who found the truth
complications: the heir does not want it
there are two possible heirs
the claim would start a war
things: a ring, mark or code only the heir carries
a letter from the dead parent
places: the seat of the power they would inherit

tags.name: Hungry Wild
tags.description: The land around this place is turning against the people in it.
enemies: a beast that has learned to hunt people
the spirit or force behind the change
a poacher making it worse
friends: a hunter who reads the signs
an outcast who lives in the wild unharmed
a farmer losing everything
complications: the land is answering a real wrong done to it
the town cannot move and cannot stay
the cure would cost the town its livelihood
things: the totem, marker or machine at the heart of it
a trophy from the first attack
an old map of what the land used to be
places: the edge of the cleared ground

tags.name: Sacred Lie
tags.description: The thing everyone here believes in is false, and someone powerful knows it.
enemies: the keeper of the lie
a true believer who will kill to protect it
a cynic who would use the truth as a weapon
friends: a doubter who asked one question too many
a novice who found the proof
a pilgrim who came for answers
complications: the lie holds the community together
the truth is worse than the lie
exposing it would hurt the innocent most
things: the relic, record or idol at the centre

tags.name: Gold Rush
tags.description: Something valuable has been found here, and people are flooding in for it.
enemies: a claim-jumper with hired guns
the company that wants all of it
the thing that guarded the riches
friends: the original finder, pushed aside
a supplier getting rich honestly
a newcomer in over their head
complications: it is running out faster than anyone admits
taking it is poisoning the place
it is not what they think it is

tags.name: Haunted Past
tags.description: A massacre, betrayal or disaster happened here, and it is not finished.
enemies: the restless dead or the memory that will not fade
the last living culprit
someone keen to repeat it
friends: the last witness
a descendant of the victims
a historian nobody listens to
complications: a respected family's fortune came from it
the dead want something the living cannot give
the official story is a lie everyone tells
places: the house where the guilty still live

tags.name: Secret Police
tags.description: Someone is watching everyone here, and everyone knows it.
enemies: the spymaster
a neighbour turned informant
an agent sent to watch the party
friends: a forger of papers
a watcher who has had enough
a family hiding someone
complications: the watchers are catching real criminals too
helping anyone marks them
the party is already in the files
things: a way into the watchers' archive
places: a café full of quiet listeners

tags.name: Siege
tags.description: This place is cut off, by an army, a storm, a wall or a disaster.
enemies: the besieger's commander
a hoarder inside the walls
a traitor ready to open the gate
friends: the defender holding things together
a runner who knows a way out
a cook stretching the last stores
complications: the besiegers have a fair grievance
help from outside has its own price
time is on the besieger's side
things: a secret way in or out

tags.name: Feuding Families
tags.description: Two families, clans, crews or houses are at each other's throats.
enemies: the head of the angrier family
a cousin who profits from the feud
a killer settling an old score
friends: two lovers across the line
an elder who remembers why it started
a neutral innkeeper losing trade
complications: both sides have blood on their hands
the feud hides a bigger crime
peace would expose someone
things: the object the feud started over
a body that was never found
places: the neutral ground where they meet

tags.name: Strange Visitors
tags.description: Outsiders have arrived, and nobody knows what they want.
enemies: the visitors' true leader
a local who wants them gone by any means
the thing that followed them
friends: a visitor who wants to stay
a translator caught in the middle
a child who befriended them
complications: the visitors are fleeing something worse
their customs offend something sacred
they brought something everyone wants
things: a message from where they came from
a gift with a hidden purpose
places: the meeting hall where they are judged

tags.name: Forbidden Knowledge
tags.description: Someone here is studying what should not be studied.
enemies: the scholar, brilliant and failing
a patron funding the work
what the research has called up
friends: an apprentice who is scared
a censor with a conscience
a victim of an earlier experiment
complications: the research could save many lives
it is already copied elsewhere
stopping it means destroying something irreplaceable
places: the place where things went wrong

tags.name: Fallen Glory
tags.description: This place was once great and now lives on its memories.
enemies: a noble clinging to old privileges
a scavenger stripping the ruins
a rival town eager to finish it off
friends: a keeper of the old ways
a young dreamer with a plan
a returning exile
complications: the old greatness was built on cruelty
reviving it means giving up something real
everyone wants a different past back
things: the symbol of the old days
the plans for what was never finished

tags.name: Underworld
tags.description: Crime runs this place in the open, with its own rules and its own courts.
enemies: the boss
an ambitious lieutenant
a crusader cleaning up with a heavy hand
friends: a fence with a code
a crook trying to go straight
an honest official keeping a low profile
complications: the crime keeps order better than the law did
cutting off the head leaves a war
the party needs something only the underworld has
places: the docks or depot at night

tags.name: Dying Trade
tags.description: What this place lives on is failing: a mine, a route, a craft or a machine.
enemies: a buyer circling to take it cheap
a boss squeezing the workers harder
whoever is causing the failure on purpose
friends: the oldest worker
an inventor with a risky fix
a trader who still believes
complications: the failure is natural and nobody can stop it
the fix would cost jobs
a new trade would bring new masters
things: the broken part or exhausted source
a new source nobody knows about
the books that show the truth

tags.name: Rising Cult
tags.description: A new faith, movement or idea is spreading fast and changing people.
enemies: the prophet
the prophet's enforcer
an old authority that wants the movement crushed
friends: a convert with doubts
the family of someone who joined
an old priest or leader losing their flock
complications: the movement does real good
the prophet believes every word
persecution makes it stronger
things: the source of the prophet's power
places: the place of the first miracle

tags.name: Hidden Door
tags.description: There is a way into somewhere else here, and only a few people know it.
enemies: the keeper of the door
something coming through from the other side
a treasure hunter willing to wreck it
friends: a guide who has been through
someone stranded from the other side
an old map-maker
complications: the door only opens at a cost
the other side wants out
the door is the town's secret wealth
things: something brought back from the other side
the map of where it leads
places: the cellar, tunnel or ruin around it
the house built to hide it
